name: Kieron Hunter
quote: Prompt to take the job and did an amazing job. Never thought a new driveway would bring so much joy. Can't stop looking at it. I'm very particular and a perfectionist so Andrew was great as he just made suggestions outside what I thought and I took the advice – so glad I did. Get him over – he won't disappoint.

name: Jack Fogarty
quote: Phillips Concrete Constructions completed an exposed aggregate job at my residence in Leopold. Extremely professional, excellent communication, extremely experienced in all concreting construction, a very neat job, everything was left spotless on completion. We are extremely impressed with the outcome. Highly recommend Andrew and his team. We will definitely be using Phillips Concrete on our next build. Thanks again guys.

name: Willow Saints
quote: Andrew and his team did an amazing job setting the concrete base for our pool. Andrew highlighted some considerations that I hadn't even thought of (drainage etc). His input and ideas not only helped me plan better but no doubt he has saved me a lot of money and headaches down the line. I cannot recommend Andrew and his team highly enough. The communication, feedback and quick timelines have made it a pleasant experience and at a fair price too.

name: Matt
quote: Phillips Concreting did our paths around the sides & back of our property. It was an extremely difficult job due to the location of our house (on the side of a hill), but Andy & his team did an amazing job & we couldn't be happier with the final result. On top of this, they were friendly, reliable & professional throughout the process. I couldn't recommend Phillips Concreting more highly!

name: Nicole
quote: I would highly recommend Andrew from Phillips Concrete Construction, he was absolutely fabulous to deal with. He offered professional advice, was hard working and completed a beautiful driveway and paths. The colour is exactly what I wanted, the shape is perfect and you can hardly see the concrete cuts. He turned up on time when he said he would. I appointed Andrew because he offered professional design advice as well as getting the quote to us quickly. Go ahead and contact Andrew, I promise, it will be the best decision you have made! What a lovely gentleman!

name: Amelia
quote: We have recently had Andrew complete our driveway and couldn't be happier with his service. He went above and beyond to meet our expectations. Thank you for all your hard work. Would highly recommend.
